meta.name: ponytail-review
meta.description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering. Finds what to delete: reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces it. Use when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we delete", "is this over-engineered", "simplify review", or invokes /ponytail-review. Complements correctness-focused review, this one only hunts complexity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码中过度设计，找出可删除的部分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望消除代码中不必要的复杂性和过度工程
copy.tagline_en: Review code for over-engineering, find what to delete
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to eliminate unnecessary complexity and over-engineering in your code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进行代码审查，只关注过度工程问题：找出可删除的代码，如重新发明的标准库、不必要的依赖、推测性抽象、无用的灵活性。每个发现输出一行：位置、要删除的内容、替换方案。
howto.when: 当你说出“review for over-engineering”、“what can we delete”、“is this over-engineered”、“simplify review”或输入“/ponytail-review”命令时触发。

say.note: Claude 会对当前代码进行过度工程审查。
Claude 会列出可删除的部分。
Claude 会简化代码审查，聚焦复杂性。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude performs code review focused exclusively on over-engineering: finds what to delete, such as reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. Each finding is one line: location, what to cut, replacement.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review for over-engineering', 'what can we delete', 'is this over-engineered', 'simplify review', or invoke '/ponytail-review'.

say_en.note: Claude will review code for over-engineering.
Claude will list what can be deleted.
Claude will simplify review, focusing on complexity.
